"---
name: project
description: CLI-based AI coding assistant built with Ink (React for terminal UIs). Call this skill when coding, debugging, or understanding this project's architecture.
---

# dscode (ONECODER)

CLI-based AI coding assistant built with Ink (React for terminal UIs), powered by OpenAI-compatible LLMs.

## Tech Stack
- **Runtime**: Bun (v1.3+)
- **Language**: TypeScript, React (TSX)
- **UI**: Ink v7 (React renderer for terminal)
- **AI**: OpenAI SDK, @ai-sdk/openai-compatible, Vercel AI SDK (ai v5)
- **State**: Zustand v5 + Immer
- **Validation**: Zod
- **CLI**: yargs
- **Styling**: chalk, cli-highlight, lowlight
- **Diffing**: diff
- **Date**: dayjs
- **Tokenizer**: gpt-tokenizer

## Commands
```
bun dev              # Start dev server with --watch
bun build            # Production bundle -> bundle/dscode.js + post-build patch
bun typecheck        # TypeScript type checking (tsc --noEmit)
bun test             # Run tests (bun test)
bun run sfe          # Compile to standalone binary (bun build --compile)
bun install          # Install dependencies
```

## Project Structure
```
index.tsx                     Entry point — renders Ink app, sets up error handlers, global state
src/
  App.tsx                     Root component: History, TextInput, Approval, ExitHandler
  agent/                      AI agent engine
    index.ts                  Re-exports: Core, codeAgent, tool types
    src/
      agents/                 Agent implementations (codeAgent, compactAgent)
      core/index.ts           Core class — OpenAI chat loop, streaming, tool registration
      prompts/                System prompts (codeAgent, compact)
      tools/                  Agent tools: bash, edit, glob, ls, read, skill, todo, write, askUserQuestion
      utils/                  Utilities: constants, error, ignore, list, model, applyEdit, read, safeStringify
  commands/                   Slash-command system
    command.ts                BaseCommand abstract class + CommandRegistry
    build-in/                 Built-in commands: config, exit, help, init, model, new, one:*
  components/                 Ink UI components
    TextInputWithPrompts.tsx  Main input with suggestions, file-search, command routing
    History.tsx, Thinking.tsx, StatusBar.tsx, DiffViewer.tsx, Tips.tsx, etc.
    approval/                 Approval UI (QuestionAnswer)
  contexts/                   React contexts (OverflowContext)
  logger/                     Message & crash logging
  skills/                     SkillsManager — .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md loading & caching
  store/                      Zustand stores (bar, agent, config, userConfig, approval, history, messageHistory)
    index.tsx                 AppStoreProvider, useStoreContext hook, persist middleware
  themes/                     13+ built-in terminal color themes (ANSI, Dracula, Ayu, GitHub, etc.)
    theme-manager.ts          ThemeManager singleton
  utils/                      Utilities: colors, fileSearch, resolveAtReferences, platform, versionCheck, etc.
scripts/
  post-build.ts               Post-build patch (replaces react-devtools-core import)
docs/
  designs/, plans/            Design documents & implementation plans
```

## Conventions
- Uses `.js` extension in import paths (Bun ESM convention), e.g. `import './foo.js'`
- Functional React components with Ink primitives (Box, Text, etc.)
- Zustand stores accessed via `useStoreContext` hook, mutations use Immer `produce`
- Built-in commands extend `BaseCommand` abstract class and register with `CommandRegistry`
- AI streaming via `Core.stream()` async generator yielding `StreamEvent` types
- Tools define a `ReturnDisplay` type for UI rendering of tool results
- User preferences (thinkingMode, agentMode) persist via Zustand persist middleware
- Skills are loaded from `.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with YAML frontmatter

## Modes
- **agentMode**: `agent` (standard, asks for approvals) | `yolo` (auto-approve all actions)
- **thinkingMode**: `off` | `high` | `max` — controls reasoning effort for LLM API calls

## Common Operations
- `bun dev` — start in watch mode for development
- `bun build` — build production bundle (minified, external: react-devtools-core)
- `bun test` — run all tests (Bun native test runner)
- `bun typecheck` — run TypeScript type checking
